long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Dusk is when the restlessness gets run off, and I am wound up enough to need it.
The moon is hiding something at new moon, and I mean to watch where it hides it.
steps.topic: the moon's colour at new moon

steps.reason: The telescope is mine and the view through it should be on record.

today.reason: Hunger is empty and the bowl will not be filled until morning, so I will not waste the dusk; I will spend it on zoomies and the telescope.
